rows.note: Use this as the neutral, all-purpose way to describe a person addicted to a substance or activity.

example.english: He used to be an addict, but he has quit drugs.
example.traditional: 佢以前係上癮嘅人，而家戒咗毒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ji5 cin4 hai6 soeng6 jan5 ge3 jan4 ji4 gaa1 gaai3 zo2 duk6

rows.note: Use this established term mainly for a person addicted to harmful drugs, rather than for every kind of addiction.

example.english: That addict hangs around the back alleys all the time.
example.traditional: 嗰個癮君子成日喺後巷流連。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 jan5 gwan1 zi2 seng4 jat6 hai2 hau6 hong6 lau4 lin4

rows.note: Use this colloquial and often disapproving term for a drug addict in casual speech.

example.english: Don’t hang out with that addict.
example.traditional: 你唔好同嗰個癮仔一齊玩。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 tung4 go2 go3 jan5 zai2 jat1 cai4 waan2
